class.name: JustAMCPToolsetRegistry
class.brief_description: Registry for modular JustAMCP toolsets and lazy discovery meta-tools.
class.description: Allows modules to register named toolsets with schema providers and executors. When [code]blazium/justamcp/enable_toolset_discovery[/code] is enabled, clients discover tools via [code]blazium_list_toolsets[/code], [code]blazium_describe_toolset[/code], and [code]blazium_call_toolset[/code].

method.name: call_toolset
method.description: Executes [param tool_name] inside [param toolset_name] with [param arguments] and returns the tool response dictionary. Unknown or disabled toolsets return an error dictionary.

method.name: describe_toolset
method.description: Returns a dictionary describing [param name], including tool schemas when the toolset is enabled. Unknown or disabled toolsets return an error dictionary.

method.name: is_discovery_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [code]blazium/justamcp/enable_toolset_discovery[/code] is enabled in project or editor settings.

method.name: list_toolset_names
method.description: Returns the sorted list of registered toolset names.

method.name: list_toolsets
method.description: Returns a result dictionary with [code]ok[/code], [code]toolsets[/code], and [code]count[/code] describing each registered toolset.

method.name: register_toolset
method.description: Registers a toolset named [param name] with [param description], schema provider [param get_schemas], and executor [param execute_tool].

method.name: unregister_toolset
method.description: Removes the toolset named [param name] and frees any owned provider object.
